description: This CMake script defines a function GetExternalCode that facilitates fetching code from a remote git repository during the build configuration process. It handles cloning, checking out specific versions, and optional force removal of existing sources.
external_files: executes GIT commands via the GIT_EXECUTABLE

methods.name: GetExternalCode
methods.description: Fetches a repository from a remote git source during build configuration, with options for specific version checkout and force clean.
